head: 3f85eafece9dc9ada7ce68bcc92faa104384dcee

source.ref: fixed by b5dcdb3 (stray plugin, #141) and eadf263 (exit code order, #162); the nothing-reviewed claim fixed by a512827 and 30f2558 after ocra runs reported it; safeMarkdown fixed earlier by 0981bbd

rationale: A sed edit added a function to the built-in plugin list, and the new incomplete-review check sits after the blocking return, so both bugs are visible in the diff. ADR-0036: the two claims on report.ts (one range, one fingerprint) are merged into one optional claim, found once each by a model and in no other run; the safeMarkdown claim is optional, since it is pre-existing code the change does not touch; stray-plugin's minSeverity drops to suggestion, since its fix calls it harmless. exit-order is optional and marked for vetting again, until the second rater has seen it: the same return order already stood at base for other checks, the same diff documents exit 3 as applying only without a blocking verdict, and the harm shows in action.yml, outside the change.

expect.concern: coverageGaps is a helper function, not a plugin, yet it was added to BUILTIN_PLUGINS; it type-checks because functions have a name, and registers nothing.
A blocking verdict returns exit 1 before the new coverage check, so a review that left files unreviewed exits 1 instead of 3, and the action lets 1 pass by default.

coverageGaps calls a run nothing-reviewed whenever no file ends up reviewed, so a run that reviewed only unchanged files carried over, or files one reviewer finished while another reviewer's task on them failed, replaces the summary with 'Nothing was reviewed' and skips judge_finished while its findings and verdict stand.
safeMarkdown breaks inline links only, so a reference-style link in model text ([text][1] with a [1]: definition) still renders as a live link whose label hides its target.

adjudicated.label: valid
adjudicated.reason: Real: with unchanged files and every new file failed or unreviewed, nothingReviewed replaces the summary and suppresses judge_finished though carried-over findings stand (run.ts:171-186); the verdict itself is kept. Still on main. (checked against the code by the agent, 2026-09-28)
adjudicated.title: coverageGaps incorrectly treats unchanged files as unreviewed, leading to incorrect "Nothing was reviewed" status

adjudicated.reason: Real: a file counts as failed when any of its reviewers' tasks failed, even if another reviewer finished it, so a run where one reviewer completes every file and another fails reports nothing reviewed, replaces the summary and suppresses judge_finished; still on main (checked against the code by the agent, 2026-09-29)
adjudicated.title: Incorrect nothingReviewed evaluation in multi-reviewer scenarios with partial task failures
